simple.summary: חֲלוֹף (chălôwph) means properly, surviving ; by implication (collectively) orphans First listed occurrence: Prov 31 8.

definitions.full: H2475. chaloph חֲלוֺף noun masculine a passing away, vanishing (properly Infinitive of חלף ) — ח ׳בְּנֵי Prov 31:8 i.e. those who are passing away, transitory (compare Qal 1 b. ).
